notes.title: Welcome to 0.4.1!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone, with you again the developer of this game Xrisofor![/h3]

In a few days I'm releasing the first fix of the 0.4.0 update, something I changed and something I removed. Thanks for continuing to play and share information about the game! Expect further updates and news in the [url=https://vk.com/crucialexperim]VK[/url] group or on the [url=https://discord.gg/RNzGSkGhqz]Discord[/url] server. I will continue to make updates and you can check out the list of changes below.

[h3]List of changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added social network icons to the main menu
[*] Fixed an issue with some achievements
[*] New achievements (maybe some still don't have their icons)
[*] Fixed some bugs and errors
[*] Possible workshop fix
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to 0.4.0!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone, with you again the developer of this game Xrisofor![/h3]

I have released what I think is the biggest update for the game yet, you can now access a small part of the continuing story in the airplane, as well as a redesigned beginning and some importance of your choices. This update is not complete, so it may be missing some parts that I have planned for the future. Expect further updates and news in the [url=https://vk.com/crucialexperim]VK[/url] group or on the [url=https://discord.gg/RNzGSkGhqz]Discord[/url] server. I will continue to make updates and you can check out the list of changes below. Good luck everyone and have a good start to the new school year, which starts in 10 days.

[h3]List of changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completely new sprites
[*] Added scene inside the airplane
[*] Added items
[*] Temporarily removed English language
[*] Updated the game code and reworked the combat system
[*] Added more sounds and some music
[*] New achievements (some may still not have their own icon)
[*] Added video inserts when showing memes for cryptic
[*] Added action selection
[/list]
